title: MLOps Engineer Roadmap
summary: Build software and cloud engineering foundations first, then learn how to automate, deploy, monitor and govern machine-learning systems reliably at production scale.

facts.Current degree: B.Tech / B.E. — CSE - Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme beginning in 2026 and progressing through 2030.

rows.text: Python, Git, Linux, networking and programming fundamentals
3 Python programs + 50 programming problems + GitHub repo with README
Linux administration, Bash, computer networks, databases and SQL
Configure a Linux VM + write 30 SQL queries + document basic network troubleshooting
DSA, APIs, software testing, Docker and CI fundamentals
Containerise an application + automated test workflow that runs on every push
Cloud fundamentals, infrastructure as code and Kubernetes basics
Deploy a containerised service + reproduce infrastructure from code
ML lifecycle, experiment tracking, model registry and data pipelines
Build a tracked ML experiment pipeline with versioned data/model artifacts
Model serving, CI/CD, monitoring, internship/open source
Deploy a model API with automated tests, logging, metrics and rollback procedure
Kubernetes, cloud ML platforms, security and reliability
Run a production-style ML workload on Kubernetes with health checks and observability
Portfolio, architecture, cost/performance optimisation and interviews
3 production-style ML systems + architecture diagrams + 5 mock interviews

blocks.text: Use the additional year for advanced distributed systems, Kubernetes/platform engineering, cloud architecture, ML research infrastructure or a substantial industry/open-source project. The BCA-specific 3-year/4-year credit figures do not apply to this B.Tech/B.E. roadmap.

rows.text: FastAPI, containers, model servers, GPUs, observability
Airflow, Spark, SQL, object storage, orchestration
IAM, secrets, supply-chain security, model evaluation

blocks.text: Move from maintaining deployment pipelines to designing AI platforms: multi-model serving, GPU infrastructure, distributed training/inference, platform security, observability, reliability and cost management. Develop architecture and leadership skills while staying technically capable of evaluating new ML infrastructure.

items: Senior MLOps Engineer / ML Platform Engineer

blocks.label: 12+ years
blocks.text: Platform architecture, technical leadership or AI infrastructure leadership
These are planning ranges, not guaranteed promotion timelines.

The long-term path is from pipeline implementation toward AI-platform architecture. Build expertise in distributed training and inference, GPU infrastructure, model serving, platform security, observability, reliability, FinOps and governance. The ability to connect ML requirements with dependable infrastructure becomes increasingly important as AI systems become larger and more operationally complex.
